after: Stem II (Preterit belegt: mʕazallan (1pl) / Infectum nicht belegt; Part act. mʕazyone (Plural)): 1: Beileid aussprechen, Hinterbliebene trösten

new_senses.rationale: mʕazallan is a finite 1pl action in a funeral-visiting sequence; mʕazyone denotes visiting condolence-givers. Together they support one verbal meaning rather than an entry inferred only from an agent noun.

added_examples.turoyo: <...> Latwolle waxt, uṯewolle mʕazyone, fayšiwo kafine. <...>
added_examples.translation: <...> They had no time; mourners would come to them, and they would remain hungry. <...>
added_examples.rationale: New Part act. box under the glossary’s agent-noun convention; source distinguishes visitors from the bereaved household.
added_examples.translation_note: Project machine translation, not an edition translation; semantic decisions are based on Turoyo.

added_examples.translation: Uncle Isho: On the first day the relatives would carry them to him; they would bring two or three sets of food; then they would give it to the mourners who came to the gathering. <...>

added_examples.translation: <...> And I went to his people, we offered condolences, and we came to Midyat. <...>
